# Traefik — root-to-custom-context-servlet-mapping

Proxy at /ui/, app on /app context with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*. The Hilla paths strip the servlet mapping and then gain the context prefix; everything else only gains /app. Needs the session cookie path and the X-Forwarded-Prefix middleware, as every scenario does where the proxy hides the context.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# Proxy at /ui/, app on the /app context with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*. The
# public URL drops the context prefix; the proxy puts it back when forwarding.
#
# Hilla's resources are the awkward part again: they sit at the backend's
# context root, so /ui/HILLA/* and /ui/connect/* become /app/HILLA/* and
# /app/connect/* — strip the servlet mapping, then add the context
# (vaadin/hilla#289). Everything else only gains /app, so /ui/* arrives as
# /app/ui/* for the Vaadin servlet, including /ui/VAADIN/push.
#
# The two middlewares run in the order listed, which is what makes
# strip-then-add work as a single translation.
http:
  routers:
    hilla-push:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/HILLA/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui
        - add-app
        - forwarded-root
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    hilla-connect:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/connect/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui
        - add-app
        - forwarded-root
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    root:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 1
      middlewares:
        - add-app
        - forwarded-root
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    strip-ui:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/ui"

    add-app:
      addPrefix:
        prefix: /app

    # addPrefix emits no X-Forwarded-Prefix of its own, and without this the
    # backend builds cookie paths and redirects around /app — which the public
    # URL does not have. "/" and not "": an empty value removes the header.
    forwarded-root:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          X-Forwarded-Prefix: "/"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
